content: कार्तिक {%a.%} (-की|{%f.%}) [कृत्तिका-अण्] Belonging to the month of Kārtika; कार्तिकीषु सवितानहर्म्यभाक् <ls>R. 19. 39</ls>. .{@-कः@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of the month in which the full moon is near the कृत्तिका or Pleiades (corresponding to October-November). .²2 An epithet of Skanda. .{@-की@} The full moon day in the month of Kārtika (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>त्रिपुरी पौर्णिमा</ns>). कार्तिक्याः प्रभृति आग्रहायणी मासे <ls>Mbh.</ls> on <ls>P. II. 3. 28</ls>.
